name: 46580 · Warsaw, IN
findings: ZIP 46580 (Warsaw) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46580 (Warsaw) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46580 (Warsaw) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
